label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set in the deployment environment, which is why password reset (and other) email links point to localhost instead of the real site. Fix by ensuring PUBLIC_URL is always set in production config, and/or fail loudly (or use a correct default) when it's missing rather than silently falling back to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset (and other) email links defaulting to localhost
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, so password reset, rollup, and scheduled export emails all point at localhost in production. This matches the reported bug: reset links not loading for users.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL (or an equivalent production config value, e.g. config.publicUrl) is always set/read correctly in the production environment, and change the fallback in templates.ts to fail loudly (throw or log an error) rather than silently defaulting to localhost, so misconfiguration is caught before emails go out with broken links.
